continue_recommended_reason: Charter stop_promote_rule satisfied and exhausted: the frozen rubric was applied to 9 accepted live bundles (>=3 required, all pre-repair), the minimum-population rule resolved with a real verdict rather than INSUFFICIENT_POPULATION, non-vacuity was actually proven (7/7 injected classes, 5 defect criteria), the verdict is unchanged under both pre-declared sensitivity variants and is reproduced by an independent second implementation. The charter mandates TERMINATE immediately after the verdict plus at most one bounded cause, and forbids growing into prompt engineering, provider work, lexicon design, benchmark construction or a product patch. Nothing specific to another cycle under THIS charter is justified: there is no known defect in this team's own harness left open (the one defect found this cycle, the frozen-digraph/regex interaction, was fixed and regression-covered). Re-measuring the same bytes, re-measuring an already-measured bundle, re-verifying the machine gate or re-running frontier-generative-audit are all forbidden by the charter. A post-repair re-measurement against this same frozen RULES.json is a NEW charter (it would be a before/after pair, not a continuation) and must be raised by the director, not continued here.
